description: This file contains the main activity (MainActivity) for an Android application demonstrating effective navigation patterns. It defines the primary fragment activity setup, including an action bar with tabs, a view pager for swiping between sections, and nested fragments for demonstration purposes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the navigation tabs, view pager, and fragment integration for the app.

classes.name: AppSectionsPagerAdapter
classes.description: Pager adapter providing fragments for each section of the app, including a launchpad and dummy sections.

classes.name: LaunchpadSectionFragment
classes.description: Fragment representing the launchpad section, providing buttons to demonstrate collection browsing and external activities.

classes.name: DummySectionFragment
classes.description: Placeholder fragment displaying adjustable text for different sections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the view, action bar tabs, and view pager.

methods.name: onTabUnselected
methods.description: Handles tab unselection events. Currently empty.

methods.name: onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles tab selection, updating the view pager to display the selected section.

methods.name: onTabReselected
methods.description: Handles tab reselection events. Currently empty.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment based on the tab's position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of sections (3).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title string for each section.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates and initializes the fragment's view, including setting up button click listeners.
